rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday term, especially for physical stamina.

example.english: After working all day, I really don't have much stamina left.
example.traditional: 做咗成日嘢，我而家真係冇乜體力喇。
example.jyutping: zou6 zo2 seng4 jat6 je5 ngo5 ji4 gaa1 zan1 hai6 mou5 mat1 tai2 lik6 laa3

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing the ability to keep exerting yourself or withstand difficulty for a long time.

example.english: This mountain trail is so long; it really tests your stamina.
example.traditional: 呢條山路咁長，真係好考耐力。
example.jyutping: ne1 tiu4 saan1 lou6 gam3 coeng4 zan1 hai6 hou2 haau2 noi6 lik6

rows.note: Use this for the energy needed to sustain mental or general activity rather than specifically physical exertion.

example.english: Lately I have to work while looking after the kids, and I really don't have much stamina.
example.traditional: 我近排要一邊返工一邊湊仔，真係冇乜精力。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gan6 paai2 jiu3 jat1 bin1 faan1 gung1 jat1 bin1 cau3 zai2 zan1 hai6 mou5 mat1 zing1 lik6
